name: Port Gellhorn
summary: Leonida's decayed Gulf Coast resort and shipping port, where tourists departed decades ago and the regional crime economy took root.
description: Situated on the western coastline of Leonida, Port Gellhorn presents a stark contrast to Vice City's neon glamour. Dilapidated motels, rusty cargo cranes, bait shops, and sun-bleached strip malls characterize this working-class coastal settlement. Port Gellhorn serves as an essential nexus for contraband offloading, container yard heists, and illicit chop shops.
